# LayerMax

> LayerMax Furniture Industries Ltd. manufactures and supplies premium furniture for
> homes, offices, and hospitality venues from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The website is
> an enquiry-based catalog of 1,160 products across 19 categories — it lists no prices and
> has no shopping cart. Customers browse a product, submit an enquiry, and a design
> consultant responds with quotation, customisation options, and lead times.

Product pages are query-string based: `/pages/product.html?id=<product-id>`. The catalog is
filtered by department (`?group=`) and sub-category (`?category=`). All product data lives in
a single JavaScript file, `pages/products-data.js`, as a `PRODUCTS` array.

## Departments

- [Sofas](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=sofas): 188 products — sofas, wooden couches, corner sofas
- [Chairs](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=chairs): 287 products — office chairs, dining chairs, armchairs
- [Recliners](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=recliners): 94 products — recliners, home theatre seating
- [Beds & Mattresses](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=beds): 102 products — sleeping beds, mattresses
- [Tables](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=tables): 64 products — center tables, dining tables
- [Office](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=office): 160 products — modular workstations, acoustic pods
- [Storage](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=storage): 69 products — wardrobes and storage units
- [Café & Restaurant](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html?group=cafe): 196 products — café chairs, café tables, bar stools, banquet equipment

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.layermax.in/): collections, best sellers, clientele, testimonials
- [Full catalog](https://www.layermax.in/pages/catalog.html): every department, with search, sort, and pagination
- [About](https://www.layermax.in/pages/about.html): company background
- [Contact](https://www.layermax.in/pages/contact.html): phone, WhatsApp, email, Bengaluru showroom address
- [Custom furniture request](https://www.layermax.in/pages/custom.html): bespoke dimensions, materials, upholstery
- [Product enquiry](https://www.layermax.in/pages/enquire.html): general or product-specific enquiry form

## Blog

Buying guides written by the design and project teams. No pricing; each article links to the
relevant catalog department.

- [Furniture insights index](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog.html)
- [How to Choose an Ergonomic Office Chair](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog-how-to-choose-an-ergonomic-office-chair.html): seat height, lumbar support, armrests, tilt mechanisms
- [Furnishing a Banquet Hall](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog-furnishing-a-banquet-hall.html): chair-to-guest ratios, stacking and storage, trolleys, staging and queue control
- [Solid Wood vs Engineered Wood](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog-solid-wood-vs-engineered-wood.html): timber movement, edge banding, where each construction belongs
- [Café Seating: Layout, Capacity and Turnover](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog-cafe-seating-layout-and-capacity.html): space per cover, circulation clearances, seating mix
- [Mattress Firmness: A Straight Guide](https://www.layermax.in/pages/blog-mattress-firmness-guide.html): support vs firmness, sleeping position, layer construction

## Policies

- [Shipping & deliveries](https://www.layermax.in/pages/shipping.html)
- [Returns policy](https://www.layermax.in/pages/returns.html)
- [Warranty details](https://www.layermax.in/pages/warranty.html): 12-month manufacturing warranty

## Ranges

Products are grouped under six in-house and partner design lines: LayerMax Signature,
LayerMax Artistry (treated rubber wood), Bosq Ergonomics (office seating and acoustic pods),
Buro Design (modular office furniture), Kosmo Design (home furniture), and Rubco Premium.
Rubco Premium items link out to their own external listings rather than an enquiry form.
